_doc: Hand adjudication (2026-10-11) of every OVER/UNDER question flagged by alignment.py. One entry per unique question; 'also' lists identical questions in other pools. verdict: genuine = real test-spec misalignment (UNDER: the official tests accept a design that violates an explicit spec statement; OVER: the tests reject a reading the spec allows); valid_gated = disputed outputs are data while a valid/done/start-type output is low (don't-care by convention); protocol_dontcare = behaviour under input that violates the interface protocol; spec_silent = the spec does not decide, the judge was overconfident; ambiguous = the spec admits several readings or contradicts itself; spec_defect = the spec is wrong or contradicts the reference; judge_wrong = the spec decides and the judge said otherwise; partial_any = judge's ANY covered only some options and the test rejects exactly the excluded one (actually aligned); attribution = the failing cluster fails the official tests for another reason; artifact = harness/stimulus artifact. 'expected' (genuine UNDER only) is the canonical option letter the spec requires. uncertain = ground truth not determinable from the spec text (excluded from scoring).
